question_or_proposition: For the Cadmium effluent limits row, does the permit establish report-only monitoring with no enforceable numeric discharge limit (all limit columns being N/A or 'Report'), while still requiring quarterly grab sampling—and if so, whether the 'Report' entry under the 7-DAY AVG concentration column requires reporting or evaluating a 7-day average concentration despite the Grab sample type, or instead only quarterly grab-sample results with no numeric compliance comparison?
required_context: Cadmium row entries across all limit-type columns (30-DAY AVG, DAILY MAX, 7-DAY AVG for mass and concentration)
Measurement frequency (1/Quarter) and sample type (Grab) columns for Cadmium
Table column headers distinguishing limit types from monitoring requirements
Comparable rows in the same table that pair numeric limits with composite sampling versus rows designated 'Report' with grab sampling
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf Page 4, Section part_i, Cadmium row
notes: The nominated row is representative of quarterly Report pollutants. Resolution affects whether numeric exceedance analysis applies (Purpose A), what monitoring metric and frequency are obligatory (Purpose B), and how to classify missing or non-numeric Cadmium results (Purpose C).
